handoff.must_be_able_to_do: Write two direction cards without going back to the client, and see which facts are high and which are low confidence
handoff.does_not_include: A full PRD, any solution direction, and any research not yet done

8.skip_reason: Short route: no new research this round; step 7 client questions cover the gaps
8.run_when: Discovery path with time for primary research

9.skip_reason: Short route: no new transcripts or secondary research this round
9.run_when: Step 8 produced new interviews or desk research

10.skip_reason: Short route: all material arrived and was converted at step 1

11.skip_reason: Short route: synthesis folded into step 12
11.run_when: A large engagement with many sources

14b.skip_reason: No current platform exists (no mock, screenshots or live product)
14b.run_when: There is a current platform to review

20.skip_reason: The client did not ask for an HTML summary
20.run_when: The client wants an HTML summary
